title: He Saved 8,000 by Spending 12,000
idea: Black Friday week: Battery walks in behind a tower of delivery boxes, proud he 'saved eight thousand' by spending twelve on things he doesn't need (a pasta maker he never uses, a massage gun, a gadget he can't identify). Kalu, deadpan with his coffee: 'Not buying it was a hundred percent off.' Battery's phone buzzes: buy two, get one free.
lines: see lines.json (captions) and tts.json (text with audio tags sent to ElevenLabs)
facts: No fact claims. Timing: Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday 27 November (day after US Thanksgiving, 26 Nov); early Black Friday deals run all week, so a purchase on 23 Nov is plausible.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Friday_(shopping) (day after the fourth Thursday of November; sales now stretch across the week)
Research: scrapecreators YouTube search (popular relatable animation shorts: family/everyday 2D comedy at 27-40 s leads with 33M-187M views)
pacing_brief: Hook = Battery bursting with the relatable brag (SAVED eight thousand in the Black Friday sale) in the first second, close shot, then pull back to reveal the box tower. 22.5 s, 9 short lines, ~17 shots: cut on every line, punch-in on SAVED, two cutaways of items rising out of boxes (pasta maker, massage gun) on the words, Battery close with the mystery gadget, Kalu close-ups for each deadpan reply, cut to Kalu extreme close on 'hundred percent', phone-screen insert with a buzz as the twist, Battery tempted, abrupt end on Kalu's deadpan face (loops to the start: he is about to buy more). Natural speed: Kalu atempo 1.06-1.08, Battery 1.05, gaps 0.15-0.25 s, 0.75 s air for the buzz before the last line.
